# Synthetic Llama reference fixtures

Generated by `scripts/hf_reference.py --fixtures testdata/hf-llama` with seed
132, Transformers 4.57.1, Torch 2.8.0 CPU eager attention, and Safetensors 0.6.2.
These are randomly initialized tiny models, not downloaded pretrained weights.
F16 and BF16 copies are quantized from the same seeded F32 state, then restored
to FP32 for reference inference. Reference JSON includes weights' SHA-256.

Each fixture has two layers, six query heads, two KV heads, hidden width 24,
intermediate width 40, a 258-token vocabulary, and 128-token context.
The 37 input IDs cross a 32-token KV page boundary. Go tests use the first
35 IDs for prefill and the last two for teacher-forced decode, comparing
against Transformers' full-sequence causal forward.
